groups.comparison: Full exact2523 source lines. Actual generated-row-to-web views retain canonical enum conversions for personality, religion arrangement, anatomy, intervention route, availability and endpoint. Independent personality/training/skills axes may coexist and do not form one exclusive archetype. F102 Pending factory uses empty connection fields and Ready projection fills them, exact normal constructor support; viewer character selection independent. F198 item-kind plus common default-filled conditional fields, F199 repairable durability payload, F115 weapon mode booleans survive in CatalogItemView, connected source supports rather than independent duplicate taxonomy. Protection/attachment/food/alcohol/durability capabilities independent of primary kind; default Simple fixture with false weapon flags is valid absence, not no-capability Weapon witness. Generic display quality not automatically durability-only. F234 request kind and raw payload copied unchanged at internal view, exact normal malformed fixture is deliberate projection seam not ordinary producer evidence. F235 role quantity0 unlimited preserved, purpose independent of editable name/requirements. F240 optional excursion anchor plus elapsed and F245 current location option fields propagate unchanged; transport fixtures intentionally retain independently chosen fields and do not establish ordinary inconsistent party. JourneyEndpoint itself already owns variants; return leg optional is actual retained one-way/round-trip authority with its native admission still separate. Investigation availability owns Unavailable details; reason, possible travel and wait can describe independent constraints, including intentionally TravelRequired+wait45 fixture, so do not force reason-exclusive detail from names alone. SATS normalization is real protocol conversion and arbitrary schema Value is open query metadata; no enum per dynamic JSON key. Source tests read, never run.
groups.disposition: Existing native-to-view payload obligations supported; actual typed adapters and independent axes preserved
